recent_posts.title: This Week in Rust 641 · This Week in Rust
recent_posts.summary: Issue 641 of This Week in Rust covers the latest community updates including project/tooling releases (Feedr v0.4.0, CGP v0.7.0, Ply 1.0), observations on Rust patterns with Postgres, zero-cost abstractions vs SIMD, and async futures. Upcoming Rust events are listed globally through April 2026.
